use default

let small = [
    "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven",
    "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen",
    "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen", "eighteen", "nineteen"
]

let tens = [
    "twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty",
    "sixty", "seventy", "eighty", "ninety"
]

let scales = ["thousand", "million", "billion"]

let irregular_ordinals = [
    ("one", "first"), ("two", "second"), ("three", "third"),
    ("five", "fifth"), ("eight", "eighth"), ("nine", "ninth"),
    ("twelve", "twelfth")
]

below_hundred(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 20 then
        small[value]
    elif value % 10 == 0 then
        tens[value / 10 - 2]
    else
        "{tens[value / 10 - 2]}-{small[value % 10]}"
    fi

below_thousand(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 100 then
        below_hundred(value)
    elif value % 100 == 0 then
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred"
    else
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred {below_hundred(value % 100)}"
    fi

cardinal(value: int) -> string is
    if value == 0 then
        return small[0]
    fi

    let named = LIST()
    let rest mut = value
    let scale mut = 0

    while rest > 0 do
        let part = rest % 1000

        if part > 0 then
            let name = below_thousand(part)

            let scaled =
                if scale == 0 then name else "{name} {scales[scale - 1]}" fi

            named.insert(0, scaled)
        fi

        rest = rest / 1000
        scale = scale + 1
    od

    return named |> join(" ")
si

ordinal(value: int) -> string is
    let words = cardinal(value)
    let cut =
        System.Math.max(words.last_index_of(' '), words.last_index_of('-'))
    let head = words[0..cut + 1]
    let last = words[cut + 1..<0]

    for (plain, special) in irregular_ordinals do
        if last =~ plain then
            return "{head}{special}"
        fi
    od

    return if last.ends_with("y") then "{head}{last[0..<1]}ieth"
           else "{words}th" fi
si

letters(word: string) -> int =>
    word |> filter(c => char.is_letter(c)) |> count()

let words = LIST()

let opening =
    "Four is the number of letters in the first word of this sentence,"

for word in opening.split([' ']) do
    words.add(word)
od

let described mut = 0

sentence_words() -> Pipe[string] is
    let cursor mut = 0

    while true do
        while words.count <= cursor do
            described = described + 1

            for word in cardinal(letters(words[described])).split([' ']) do
                words.add(word)
            od

            words.add("in")
            words.add("the")

            for word in "{ordinal(described + 1)},".split([' ']) do
                words.add(word)
            od
        od

        yield words[cursor]
        cursor = cursor + 1
    od
si

sentence_length(word_count: int) -> int is
    let characters = words
        |> take(word_count)
        |> map(w => w.length)
        |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)

    return characters + word_count - 1
si

write_line("the lengths of the first 201 words:")

let first_201 = sentence_words()
    |> take(201)
    |> map(letters)
    |> collect_list()

for row in 0..9 do
    let cells = first_201
        |> skip(row * 25)
        |> take(25)
        |> map(n => "{n,3}")
        |> join("")

    write_line("{row * 25 + 1,4}:{cells}")
od

write_line("sentence length so far: {sentence_length(201)}")

for target in [1_000, 10_000, 100_000, 1_000_000, 10_000_000] do
    let word = (sentence_words() |> skip(target - 1) |> first())!
    let length = sentence_length(target)

    write_line("word {target,8} is \"{word}\" with {letters(word)} letters")
    write_line("    sentence length so far: {length}")
od
